text: まー　ムリに　とは　いわんが

patterns.name: 〜とは言わない
patterns.span: ムリに　とは　いわん
patterns.explanation: とは いわない means 'I won't go so far as to say that'. と holds up the words being said and は sets them apart. ムリに　とは　いわん = 'I won't say you have to'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん on the end of a verb is the old-man and dialect way of saying ない, 'not'. いわん is the same as いわない = 'won't say'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a sentence means 'but...' and leaves the rest unsaid, which softens the words. いわんが = 'I won't say so, but...'.
